summary: Addentax Group Corp. filed an 8-K on September 30, 2026, disclosing a September 28, 2026 private placement agreement with non-U.S. investor Chan Kai Sang. The Company will issue 520,834 common shares at $4.80 per share, raising roughly $2.5 million gross under Regulation S. Proceeds are earmarked for general corporate purposes, working capital, and potential strategic investments. The closing is subject to customary conditions and the shares carry restrictive legends. This is an ordinary unregistered equity financing, not a special situation; watch for dilution and any follow-on strategic investments, but no deal terms or arbitrage angle apply.
